video_title: How the Jaylen Brown trade changed LeBron James and Rich Paul's view of the 76ers | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Ohm Youngmisuk
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's agonizing decision process before choosing the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: it was Philadelphia that made the move for Jaylen Brown that really opened their eyes

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: What can you tell us about the final days leading up to his last decision to join Philly?

text_blocks.speaker: Ohm Youngmisuk
text_blocks.text: Rich Paul detailed on his podcast with Max Kellerman that this was an agonizing decision for LeBron James. He did not make a decision until 1:00 a.m. on Friday morning. It was confirmed it was the four teams that Shams Charania had reported: Golden State, Cleveland, Miami, and Philadelphia. While LeBron felt the pull to return back to Cleveland or Miami, and he certainly felt the lure of Steph Curry and Draymond Green in Golden State, it was Philadelphia that made the move for Jaylen Brown that really opened their eyes. The Brown move changed how they viewed Philadelphia, and that is what got LeBron thinking about Philadelphia and making this basketball decision to go after a fifth championship ring.

quotes.speaker: Ohm Youngmisuk
quotes.summary_phrase: Why LeBron James and Tyrese Maxey are a strong on-court fit
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is like a solar system on himself, he has his own orbit

text_blocks.speaker: Scott Van Pelt
text_blocks.text: What do LeBron and his camp like so much about the on-court fit with Maxey?

text_blocks.speaker: Ohm Youngmisuk
text_blocks.text: If you look at some of his best success that came in Cleveland with Kyrie Irving, you could see the similarities with Tyrese Maxey. They have an established relationship. Tyrese Maxey is also a clutch client. They have known each other for five years. They have worked out together, and this is where they feel this will be a smoother transition than going to another team. When LeBron goes somewhere else, any other superstar on that team has to adjust and adapt to playing with LeBron James. LeBron James is like a solar system on himself, he has his own orbit. But with Tyrese Maxey, they feel that this will be a smoother transition. They know each other very well and they can play pick-and-roll. Rich Paul even said, perhaps Nick Nurse will pull a page out of Ty Lue's book and use Maxey as a screener for LeBron James, and LeBron James will be a secondary playmaker, the best secondary playmaker in the league.
